title: Concessive Clauses in Executive Negotiation
subtitle: Cómo ceder tácticamente ('Although', 'Even though', 'Notwithstanding') manteniendo tu postura arquitectónica
ruleSummary: Usa cláusulas concesivas para reconocer los argumentos de la otra parte ('Although this vendor offers lower upfront licensing costs...') antes de introducir tu conclusión estratégica ('...its proprietary lock-in poses severe long-term risks'). Muestra empatía ejecutiva y rigor analítico.

comparisonExamples.wrong: We shouldn't use this tool but it is cheaper.
comparisonExamples.right: Although the tool offers a lower initial price point, its total cost of ownership is significantly higher due to maintenance.
comparisonExamples.tip: 'Although' al inicio estructura un argumento maduro y convincente.

comparisonExamples.wrong: Despite we have few servers, the load is high.
comparisonExamples.right: Despite having limited compute nodes, our cluster maintained 99.99% uptime.
comparisonExamples.tip: 'Despite' y 'In spite of' exigen sustantivo o gerundio (-ing), nunca oración completa con verbo conjugado directo.

questions.prompt: _____ the tight project deadline, our team refused to bypass the automated security audit.
questions.contextSentence: Executive trade-off: Concession followed by a principled stance.
questions.spanishExplanation: Ante un sintagma nominal ('the tight project deadline'), la preposición correcta es 'Despite' o 'In spite of' (no 'Although' ni 'Even though', que requieren sujeto y verbo).
questions.audioText: Despite the tight project deadline, our team refused to bypass the automated security audit.
